🔥 रजनीकांत की फिल्म Jailer 2 ने बॉक्स ऑफिस पर तहलका मचा दिया है!

🎬 Nelson Dilipkumar के निर्देशन में बनी और Sun Pictures के Kalanithi Maran द्वारा प्रोड्यूस यह फिल्म लगातार रिकॉर्ड तोड़ रही है।

💰 report के मुताबिक, फिल्म ने 18वें दिन यानी तीसरे रविवार को 11.2 करोड़ रुपये कमाए, जिससे इसका कुल भारतीय नेट कलेक्शन 455.95 करोड़ रुपये यानी 538.04 करोड़ gross हो गया है।

🏆 यह Kollywood की पहली ऐसी फिल्म बन गई है जिसने 450 करोड़ नेट का आंकड़ा पार किया है।

📈 तीसरे weekend में फिल्म ने कुल 26.05 करोड़ रुपये कमाए और Vikram का रिकॉर्ड तोड़कर Kollywood का सबसे बड़ा तीसरा weekend दर्ज किया।

🌟 क्या आपको लगता है कि यह फिल्म 500 करोड़ के क्लब में शामिल हो पाएगी? नीचे comments में बताओ!

ctx.title: Jailer 2 Box Office Collection Day 18: Becomes First Kollywood Film To Reach 450 Crore Net, Scores A Historic 3rd Weekend As Well
ctx.summary:
Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 had a rocking third weekend at the Indian box office, overtaking Vikram with 25 crore+ net earnings. 
 The post  Jailer 2 Box Office Collection Day 18: Becomes First Kollywood Film To Reach 450 Crore Net, Scores A Historic 3rd Weekend As Well  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Rajinikanth-led Jailer 2 had another fantastic weekend at the Indian box office, raking in historic numbers yet again. The all-time blockbuster is benefiting from repeat audiences, and the same is being reflected in collections. In its last weekend, the magnum opus added another 25 crore+ net, registering Kollywood’s biggest third weekend. Also, it has crossed the 450 crore milestone. Keep reading for a detailed report of day 18!
The Kollywood action-comedy thriller scored 11.2 crore on its third Sunday, day 18. Compared to day 17’s 9.35 crore , it displayed a jump of 19.79%. Overall, the film has reached a grand total of 455.95 crore net at the Indian box office, which equals 538.04 crore gross. With this, it has become Kollywood’s first-ever 450 crore net grosser.
Given the pace, Jailer 2 has a chance to enter the 500 crore club as well. Yes, Ramayana will hog the limelight in the coming days, but Rajinikanth’s film is expected to enjoy its share of the audience, especially in Tamil Nadu.
On the third Friday, Jailer 2 earned 5.5 crore , followed by 9.35 crore on Saturday. As mentioned above, it added another 11.2 crore on its third Sunday. Overall, it scored 26.05 crore in its third weekend, and with these numbers, it registered Kollywood’s biggest third weekend at the Indian box office. It surpassed Vikram ( 21.86 crore ) to claim the throne.

Jailer 2 is directed by Nelson Dilipkumar and produced by Kalanithi Maran’s Sun Pictures. It also stars SJ Suryah, Mithun Chakraborty, Suraj Venjaramoodu, Ramya Krishnan, and Vidya Balan in key roles. The film was reportedly made on a budget of 350 crore . It was released on October 15, 2026.
